class.name: IfcCircle
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : An IfcCircle is defined by a radius and the location and orientation of the circle. Interpretation of data should be as follows: C = SELF\IfcConic.Position.Location x = SELF\IfcConic.Position.P[1] y = SELF\IfcConic.Position.P[2] z = SELF\IfcConic.Position.P[3] R = Radius and the circle is parameterized as The parameterization range is 0 £ u £ 2 p (or 0 £ u £

members.member: The radius of the circle, which shall be greater than zero.
